# @surfaces-ui/engine-duckdb

DuckDB engine adapter (Node, ADBC).

DuckDB as an engine (Node, ADBC): Parquet, CSV and JSON files, Delta and Iceberg tables, time travel, and file access locked to the registered tables.

## Install

```bash
npm install @surfaces-ui/engine-duckdb
```

## Part of Surfaces UI

Surfaces UI is a UI library for data and analytics: exploring schemas, querying, charting, tables at scale, chat, and pages an agent can build.
